title: Kymaean Alpha Stage State Witness & Redundancy Grammar 01

authority.engineer_2_status: working independently; this packet does not mutate Engineering

source_authority: APPUI Phase 2 Silence / Listening / System Non-Response 01
APPUI Phase 2 Nonverbal Action / Refusal Composition 01
APPUI Phase 3 Static App Visual System Reference 01
redundancy_principle: Every essential state requires a structural or textual witness that survives loss of color and motion. Decorative variation may reinforce, never replace, semantic witness.

witness_layers.I: Identity — human-readable Character name + stable programmatic identity; no color/portrait/position dependence.
witness_layers.P: Presence/performance — listening, speaking/performing, performed silence, nonverbal action, refusal remain explicit fictional meanings.
witness_layers.O: Opportunity — explicit independent non-color witness only when Product truth exposes current opportunity.
witness_layers.C: Creator interaction — keyboard focus and creator selection remain independent; focus uses solid outer ring reference, selection uses persistent structural edge witness at floor/name hinge.
witness_layers.R: Relationship salience — quiet composition-level grouping, never type/score/obligation/permanent graph.
witness_layers.T: Temporal/effect — current solid+label, historical dashed+label, provisional/non-effective dotted+label for supporting information.
witness_layers.A: Application/infrastructure — explicit application-side status outside Character fictional carriers.

collision_rules: identity must remain readable before all other emphasis
performance state remains explicit independently of opportunity/selection
opportunity stays independent from focus/selection/performance/relationship salience
focus and selection may coexist and remain separately perceivable
relationship salience must not obscure individual Character state
temporal/effect status applies to information surfaces, not automatically to Character performance
infrastructure must not mutate fictional Character presentation
stress_cases: selected Character while another has current opportunity
focus inside inspector while Stage selection persists
speaking Character in salient relationship while neither member is selected
performed silence with different selected and opportunity Characters
historical causal context open while Stage performance remains current
technical non-response outside Stage with fictional states unchanged
focus+selection on same Character without creating opportunity/performance
prohibited: technical state painted into Character performance
new pip/icon vocabulary without separately justified semantic need
open_variables: native focus/selection metrics beyond static reference intent

contradictions_found_and_resolved: Older color/glow-heavy treatments are retained only as reinforcement; essential state now requires structural/textual witness.
Historical neutral pips/redundant symbols remain test instrumentation and are not promoted into final identity vocabulary.
STA F2 focus/selection mechanics are preserved while Stage-specific placement is constrained to floor/name interaction hinge rather than full-cone container.
Current/historical/provisional structural vocabulary is confined to information/effect status and is not silently reused as Character-performance semantics.
